items.exampleEn: The explosion broke all the windows on the street.
items.exampleZh: 那場爆炸震碎了整條街的窗戶。

items.exampleEn: How can I get rid of my fear of dogs?
items.exampleZh: 我要怎麼擺脫對狗的恐懼？

items.exampleEn: Many English words are derived from French.
The maintenance of the old bridge takes a lot of work every year.
items.exampleZh: 這座舊橋每年的維修工作都很多。

items.exampleEn: The storm strengthened as it moved toward the coast.
items.exampleZh: 暴風雨向海岸移動時變得更強了。

items.exampleEn: The old bridge is undergoing repairs.
items.exampleZh: 那座舊橋正在進行整修。

items.exampleEn: The tower of books collapsed when the cat jumped on it.
items.exampleZh: 貓一跳上去，那疊書就倒了。

items.exampleEn: She seized my arm and pulled me back.
items.exampleZh: 她抓住我的手臂把我拉回來。

items.sentenceEn: How can I get rid of this bad smell?
items.sentenceZh: 我要怎麼去掉這股難聞的味道？

items.audioEn: The elevator is under maintenance today, so please use the stairs.
items.audioZh: 電梯今天在維修，請走樓梯。
options: Wait for the elevator to be fixed.

items.sentenceEn: We derive a lot of fun from our weekly games.
items.sentenceZh: 我們從每週的遊戲中得到很多樂趣。

items.sentenceEn: The chance was too good to miss, so I seized it.
items.sentenceZh: 機會太難得了，所以我把握住了。

items.stemEn: There has been a big ____ in the number of tourists this year.
Every new worker has to ____ two weeks of training before starting.
items.stemZh: 每位新員工開始工作前都必須接受兩週的訓練。

items.passageEn: Last month, there was a loud explosion at an old factory near my home. Luckily, it happened at night, so nobody was hurt. However, the collapse of the roof scared everyone on our street. Experts said the problem was caused by poor maintenance: nobody had checked the gas pipes for years. The police seized some papers from the office to learn more. Now workers are repairing the factory. The owners plan to strengthen the walls and get rid of the old machines. My neighbors hope the factory will be safer when it opens again.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我家附近的一間老工廠發生了一場巨大的爆炸。幸好事情發生在晚上，所以沒有人受傷。不過，屋頂倒塌把我們整條街的人都嚇壞了。專家說，問題出在維修不足：好幾年都沒有人檢查瓦斯管。警方從辦公室查扣了一些文件，以進一步了解情況。現在工人正在整修工廠。業主打算加固牆壁，並把舊機器處理掉。鄰居們希望工廠重新開放時會更安全。

options: 因為工廠已經關閉好幾年了
因為警察及早疏散了民眾
因為那天大家都去度假了
屋頂用的材料實在太舊了
工人不小心在工廠點了火
好幾年沒人檢查瓦斯管

items.promptZh: 這座城市經歷了很大的改變。
referenceEn: The city has undergone great changes.
rubricZh: undergo 表示「經歷」，例如 undergo changes 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在完成式或過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 get rid of 造一個句子，說說你想丟掉或改掉的東西。
referenceEn: I want to get rid of my old clothes.
I got rid of my habit of eating too much candy.
rubricZh: rid 表示「擺脫、除去」，例如 get rid of… 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
